sections.heading: WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO PLAY
sections.middleText1: two single or multi-message switches record: "buy it!" on one switch "no way!" on the other
sections.middleText2: home interiors catalogue, website or visit a shop

sections.heading: HOW TO PLAY
sections.body:
1. Invite the switch user to be the judge whether items would go in their dream house.
2. Look at a range of items.
3. The switch user presses a switch to respond with either "buy it"" or "no way!
